topic_en: Rust Option: why Rust has no null

xhs.title: Rust 为什么干脆不要 null？
xhs.body:
第 12 课：Option
别的语言里 null 能藏进任何引用，类型上看不出来，忘了检查就运行时崩溃
Rust 用 Option 表示"可能没有"：Some(值) 或 None
Option<i32> 不是 i32，不处理 None 就不能用，编译器帮你兜底
取值：match、if let、unwrap_or；unwrap 没值会 panic，少用
考考你：let x: Option<i32> = Some(5); match x { Some(n) => println!("{n}"), } 能编译吗？ 评论区告诉我～

douyin.title: Rust 没有 null，那“没有值”怎么办？
douyin.body:
Option 把"可能没有"写进类型，编译器逼你先处理 None。
考考你：let x: Option<i32> = Some(5); match x { Some(n) => println!("{n}"), } 能编译吗？ 评论区告诉我～

tiktok.body: Rust has no null. Option puts "maybe nothing" into the type, so the compiler makes you handle it. Quick quiz: let x: Option<i32> = Some(5); match x { Some(n) => println!("{n}"), }  Does it compile? Comment your answer.

linkedin.title: Why Rust has no null
linkedin.body:
In many languages any reference can secretly be null. The type doesn't say so, and a missed check crashes at runtime.
Safe Rust has no null references. It uses Option<T> instead: Some(value) or None.
An Option<i32> is not an i32, so the compiler makes you handle None before you use the value.
Get the value with match, if let or unwrap_or. unwrap panics on None.
Quick quiz: let x: Option<i32> = Some(5); match x { Some(n) => println!("{n}"), }  Does it compile? Answer in the comments.

quiz.q_zh: let x: Option<i32> = Some(5); match x { Some(n) => println!("{n}"), } 能编译吗？
quiz.q_en: let x: Option<i32> = Some(5); match x { Some(n) => println!("{n}"), }  Does it compile?
quiz.answer_zh: 答案：不能。match 必须穷尽所有情况，编译器只看类型不看值：x 的类型是 Option<i32>，漏了 None 就报错 E0004。
quiz.answer_en: Answer: no. match must cover every case, and the compiler checks the type, not the value: x is an Option<i32>, so a missing None arm is error E0004.
